param: A Recruitment (birth) rate into the susceptible human population (all newborns are susceptible)
β Effective transmission (infection) rate from susceptible to infected due to contact with infected individuals
δ Drop-out rate due to waning natural immunity (Recovered → Susceptible)
μ Natural death rate (applies to all compartments)
u Vaccination rate moving individuals from Susceptible to Vaccinated
ε Correction parameter for reinfection term (probability/relative success of reinfection compared to primary infection)
γ Recovery rate from active TB infection (Infected → Recovered)
